_comment: Warbanner (content pass C7, plan-content-zones12.md §13): the CAPSTONE — Vanguard L5 + CallForAid L3 (base ingredients only, PO 2026-07-18). You BECOME the rallying point (lore echo of the Warlord's WarbannerTotems): every Vanguard component nudged up (~110%) PLUS a modest enemy slow. Best GENERALIST above Vanguard — but each single component stays below the matching specialist (Spearhead damage / Lifewarden heal), so the trio keeps its best-at-X crowns; shield has no specialist, Warbanner wears that crown. Top of the §A power ceiling. Secret recipe. All values [PLACEHOLDER] pending C8. ⚑ R3/F5 (plan-resource-costs-feedback §5.5): all FOUR effects now land on the damage beat of 40 — heal 120 -> 40 (magnitude and cost /3), shield 30 -> 40 (both x1.333), slow from the absent default of 1 to an authored 40. The slow is the one to watch and the PO's condition on the ruling: it was re-applied every single tick, so it is now up to 40 ticks (~1.3 s) LATE on a mob entering the ring and lingers ~41 ticks on one leaving. The debuff itself cannot drop while the mob stays — the applier authors the buff lifetime as interval + 1 — but that is a property of the engine, so R3 pins it (skills.checkOverTimeLifetime, cmd/aurad slow-edge guard).
